en.<p class=\"eyebrow\">Barrel Roller Beari:
Barrel Roller Bearings

Barrel Roller Bearings

A self-aligning bearing assembled with barrel-shaped rollers so that the raceway centers of the inner and outer rings automatically align with the shaft center. It self-adjusts even when the shaft is deflected, and is suitable for applications with large radial loads and shock loads.

Available in cylindrical bore type (TVP) and tapered bore type (MB, taper 1:12), among others.

You can search by entering just the part number or part of the dimensions.
